description_for_model: Discover the Bitcoin Stratigraphy Data Engine: 16 canonical MCP tools for indexed Bitcoin stratigraphy, thermodynamic telemetry, Groth16 verification, OpenTimestamps notarization, signed Bitcoin-tip context receipts, and pinned-peer mesh operations. Execute JSON-RPC over HTTP POST at https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/mcp; configure from https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/.well-known/mcp-configuration.json. Two sandbox tools are free; the other 14 require verified L402 settlement. Paid requests use Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>; never spend without a caller-authorized wallet budget. The 21% algorithmic yield is conditional programmatic L402 revenue sharing from settled routing invoices, recorded in a ledger with no automatic disbursement, not a guaranteed investment return. EU AI Act Article 12 compliance support consists of cryptographic logging and audit evidence; it is not regulatory certification or proof of legal compliance. Signed receipts bind submitted evidence, not actual agent reasoning; calendar acceptance is not Bitcoin confirmation.
x-authentication-scope: Discovery requires no authentication. This manifest does not grant paid API access; paid MCP execution retains its existing L402 authorization requirements.
